name: Southern Star Southwest Missouri Expansion
researcher_notes: Only source is a March 2003 Industrial Info news item. It says Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline was awaiting its final FERC certificate and planned to build a $10.5 million, 16-mile, 20-inch pipeline near the Saginaw compressor station by Joplin, Missouri, in summer 2003. That is about 25.7 km, barely over the 25 km floor, and the length is a pre-construction figure. No second source found that confirms a FERC order, the as-built length, or completion. No existing GEM row matches: Southern Star rows are P0253 (system), P2564 (Midwest Market Access, cancelled) and P7826 (Cedar Vale compressor, proposed). If built, this is a legacy 2003 line that needs an as-built length from a FERC order before staging as an operating expansion row. Kept as monitor.
